aghs.scepter: When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases 3 waves of 2 projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.
aghs.shard:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

 Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.

aghs.scepter: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to 90% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.
aghs.shard: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.

talents.name: 1.5x Flesh Heap and Meat Shield bonuses

aghs.scepter: Increases Rot radius by 200, damage by 90, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by 20%.
aghs.shard:
When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.

When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by 50%.

aghs.scepter: Reduces cooldown by 3.5s. When targeting an enemy hero, Pugna reduces their outgoing spell damage by 8% per second up to a maximum of 75% and increases his own, up to a maximum of 100%. When draining through a Nether Ward using Shard, the rate of increase/decrease is 4% instead. Debuff lasts 8 seconds.
aghs.shard: Life Drain can target your Nether Ward, causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within 700 units of the ward for 75% of its normal value. The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.

talents.name: +35 Attack Speed against Shadow Striked units

aghs.scepter: Causes Shadow Strike to become a 375 AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.
aghs.shard: Releases a sonic boom when Queen of Pain blinks, at both her starting and ending locations. Deals 125 damage in a 300 AoE and silences the target for 1.75 seconds.

aghs.scepter: Supercharges Clockwerks abilities: Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range. Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased. Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target. Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased. Jetpack Moves faster. Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.
aghs.shard: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.

talents.name: --0.1s Eye of the Storm Strike Interval
Creates A Second Plasma Field Delayed By +30s

aghs.scepter: Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.
aghs.shard: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is =2x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by =2.0s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.

talents.name: +15% of Riki's Base damage added to Tricks of the Trade

aghs.scepter: Increases Cast Range to 900. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have 15% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts 1s longer and does an additional 2 attacks.
aghs.shard: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by 5 and cannot be targeted by their allies.

talents.name: Debuff Immunity While Channeling Tame the Beasts
+1s Impalement Arts Bleed and Slow Duration
Escape Act Grants Strong Dispel and Flying

aghs.scepter: Escape Act has 2 charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.
aghs.shard: Ringmaster shines 3 spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for 0.3 seconds after leaving the light.

aghs.scepter: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades spells to their Scepter version.
aghs.shard: Allows you to target yourself or allies with Telekinesis. Throw distance is increased to 600 and throw delay is reduced to 0.5 seconds.

aghs.scepter: When the pulses start, 3 Stinger attack areas are created every =0.5s at random locations, each measuring 35% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply =50% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause 1 attack(s).
aghs.shard: Increases Epicenter damage per pulse. Every 3.0s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.

aghs.scepter: Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain 2 charges.
aghs.shard:
Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration.  At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

aghs.scepter: Increase cast range. Every 0.9 seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within 600 of the target for 100% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within 2000 units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.
aghs.shard: Allows to create a Mega Ward using the Urnaconda ability.

talents.name: +1 Max / +1 Hero Attack Reactive Armor Stacks
Exposure Therapy Heals for +12 HP Per Tree Destroyed

aghs.scepter: Reactive Armor can now be activated to get max stacks and 150 damage barrier. Grants Timbersaw 100 + 75 barrier amount per second for each enemy hero within 450 radius of Timbersaw up to a maximum of 800. After 8 seconds, Timbersaw deals damage to every hero within 450 radius equal to 200 + his remaining barrier amount and loses all of his barrier.
aghs.shard: Releases a flame in the direction Timbersaw is facing. Applies a debuff that deals damage per second and slows enemy movement speed. Affects buildings for reduced damage.

talents.name: +7% Suffer In Silence Silenced Target Damage
+40s Glaives of Wisdom Int Steal Duration

aghs.scepter: Global Silence applies Arcane Curse to heroes for the duration of Global Silence.
aghs.shard: Causes Glaives of Wisdom to bounce 1 time to a random enemy within 450 range and increases intelligence steal.

aghs.scepter: Reduces cooldown.
aghs.shard: Mortal Strike hits curse their target, causing them to take 75% of the initial attack damage again as <font color="#d8ae53">Pure</font> damage after a 3 second delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage.

aghs.scepter: When Skywrath Mage casts Mystic Flare, another Mystic Flare will be created on the position of a different random target enemy within 500 range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.
aghs.shard: When Skywrath Mage casts Arcane Bolt, 3 bolts are created, one aimed at the original target, and two others aimed at random enemies within %extra_bolt_search_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

aghs.scepter: Provides additional HP Regen, Armor and Status Resistance while in a puddle, trail, or river. Increases puddle/trail radius by 75% and puddle/trail duration by 5s.
aghs.shard: Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.

talents.name: +1 Agility gain/stolen per Essence Shift Stack

aghs.scepter: Provides charges and increases range.
aghs.shard: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.

aghs.scepter: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.
aghs.shard: Firesnap cookies become even more potent, healing the target and launching a Mortimer Kiss that does 40% impact damage to the landing destination.

aghs.scepter: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.
aghs.shard: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.

aghs.scepter:
The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a =400 area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for =1.5s and have their movement speed slowed by 50%.

Reduces cooldown by 20s.
aghs.shard: Dispersion can be activated to increase the amount absorbed and reflected by Dispersion by 50% of its base values for 5s. Cooldown 25. Manacost 50.

aghs.scepter: Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive 25% damage), and the original target takes 25% of Greater Bash's damage again.
aghs.shard: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.

talents.name: 450 Distance Auto Remnant in Ball Lightning

aghs.scepter: Electric Vortex affects all enemies within a radius around Storm Spirit.
aghs.shard: Can be activated to grant Storm Spirit and nearby allied heroes 3 Overload charges. Provides bonus Attack Speed. Lasts up to 12 seconds or until the charges are depleted.

talents.name: -25% Storm Hammer Cooldown and Mana Cost

aghs.scepter: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional 180 damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.
aghs.shard: Increases radius and bonus movement speed. Warcry is now undispellable and provides a %base_barrier_amount% physical damage barrier.

talents.name: +25% Reactive Tazer Buff and Disarm Duration

aghs.scepter:
Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal 15% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts 240 seconds.

When an enemy Hero walks within 200 units of a minefield sign, the 1000 units area around the sign will become a minefield for 10 seconds, dealing damage to enemy Heroes any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.
aghs.shard: M.A.D. becomes an active ability. Increases max mana as damage amount. Techies plant an M.A.D. which can be detonated manually with a sub-ability. Only one M.A.D. from the active ability can be placed at a time.

aghs.scepter: When activated, traps now silence affected enemies.
aghs.shard: Increases bonus damage. Refraction can be cast while disabled.

aghs.scepter: Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.
aghs.shard: Costs part of Terrorblade's current HP to cast, providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed. Does not affect Reflection illusions. Can't be cast while in Metamorphosis and Metamorphosis will remove Demon Zeal.

talents.name: Kraken Shell Cleanse triggers Anchor Smash

aghs.scepter: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.  Decreases cooldown.
aghs.shard: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than 350 units away from the anchor forces the hero to 100 move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with 4 hero attacks.

aghs.scepter: Turrets activate faster, and fire missiles %missile_attack_rate_tooltip% faster.
aghs.shard:
Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for 2 seconds.

The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.

aghs.scepter: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.
aghs.shard: Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.

aghs.scepter: Decreases Cooldown to 85 seconds. When casting Overgrowth, Treant Protector draws power from the soil, greatly increasing his size for 16 seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of 345, 100% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals 60% of his attack damage in a 300 unit radius.
aghs.shard: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for 360 seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.

talents.name: Allies Receive Battle Trance Attack Speed

aghs.scepter:
Causes Whirling Axes (Melee) to dispel Troll Warlord. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
aghs.shard: Grants Troll 16% + 3% chance per Fervor stack of firing an additional ranged attack to any unit within its ranged attack range plus =175 when attacking an enemy unit.

talents.name: Ice Shards slow by 110% and deal 110 DPS

aghs.scepter: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within 250 radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by 50% if kicking a creep.
aghs.shard: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor. Can be put on alt-cast to only pull Tusk towards his ally with 50% reduced cast range.

aghs.scepter: Increases strength steal.
aghs.shard: Tombstone can be cast on an allied hero to bunker inside of the tombstone. Heroes that enter the Tombstone cannot leave for 2 seconds nor can they re-enter after leaving. If the tombstone is destroyed with a hero inside, that hero gets stunned for 2 seconds.

aghs.scepter: Reduces cooldown and allows Ursa to use Enrage while disabled.
aghs.shard: Earthshock applies 3 Fury Swipes to enemies hit.

talents.name: Wave Of Terror Steals +25% Of Reduced Damage And Armor

aghs.scepter:
Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells.

If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.
aghs.shard: Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within 75% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.

aghs.scepter: Decreases cooldown by 35 seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.
aghs.shard: Increases cast range and projectile speed by 25%. When Venomous Gale impacts enemy heroes, 2 Plague Wards are created around them.

aghs.scepter: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a 500 AoE for 4 seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.
aghs.shard: Increases max stacks, and causes Poison Attack to lower armor per stack and to affect buildings for reduced damage.

talents.name: +10 Armor Corruption to Visage and Familiars

aghs.scepter: Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.
aghs.shard: Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds. Restores up to 25% of your health.

aghs.scepter: Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain 2 charges.
aghs.shard: Creates an additional watcher path that rotates around the remnant.  The remnant now provides True Sight, and no longer triggers on creeps, instead dealing 50% damage to them every second in both paths. Does not reveal wards.

talents.name: +8 Upheaval Attack Speed per second on Allies
+25% Damage Resistance for Chaotic Offering Golems

aghs.scepter: Calls 2 Golems.
aghs.shard: Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.

aghs.scepter: Time Lapse may target allied Heroes with 500 cast range.
aghs.shard: Shukuchi puts a mark on enemies it damages that last 4.6 seconds. 0.2s after Weaver exits Shukuchi, enemies with a mark within 1200 range will also be attacked with a secondary Geminate attack

talents.name: Powershot Executes Enemy Heroes Under +16% Max HP
Focus Fire Kills Advance Cooldown by +16s

aghs.scepter: Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.
aghs.shard: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.

aghs.scepter: Causes Arctic Burn to be a toggle ability, draining mana every second when active. Increases Winter Wyvern's movement speed.
aghs.shard: Reduces cooldown by 4.0 seconds. Allied units gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon.

aghs.scepter: Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.
aghs.shard: Tether damages enemies touching it. Io is healed for 50% of the damage done.

talents.name: Maledict bursts deal 800% damage in a 800 AoE
+1% Target Max Health Voodoo Restoration Heal

aghs.scepter: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.
aghs.shard: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.

aghs.scepter: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.
aghs.shard: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.
